These are synthetic documents generated by `ticket-pdf`'s `DocumentFlowTest`, with
the actual PDF, its rasterization, the API artwork and matching bundled fonts.
They make frontend CI independent of another repository's ignored `target` folder.
They contain no management tokens or client documents.

To update after changing document composition:

1. Run `mvn -Dtest=DocumentFlowTest test` in the sibling `ticket-pdf` repository.
2. Run `node scripts/update-journey-fixtures.mjs` in `ticket-editor`.
3. Run `npx playwright test tests/e2e/event-artwork.spec.ts` and review the images.

Font copyright/permission notices are copied from the supplied TTF metadata to
`fonts/LICENSE.txt`. [Upstream license](https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html).
